When a fee falls due, the app creates an open item automatically (Reports → Open items) – whether or not a SEPA mandate is linked. Without a mandate the item is simply a reminder, for instance for an expected bank transfer.
translations.Erzeugt eine SEPA-XML-Datei (pain.008) a: Creates a SEPA XML file (pain.008) from every open item with an active mandate that is due by the collection date and is not already part of a pending collection. Before your first real collection, do test the file with your bank's validation tool – the exact format varies slightly between banks.
translations.Bis zu diesem Termin sind es nur noch {n: That date is only {n} days away. The SEPA rulebook requires you to tell the payer the amount and the date at least {required} days in advance – the automatic pre-notification can no longer do that in full.
translations.Vorgeschlagen sind {required} Tage Vorla: {required} days' lead time is suggested: that is what the SEPA rulebook requires for the pre-notification to the payer.
translations.Bis zum gewählten Termin ist kein offene: No open item with an active SEPA mandate is due by the selected date.
translations.{n} Zahler haben keine E-Mail-Adresse hi: {n} payers have no email address on file and could not be notified – please tell them yourself.
translations.Einzug mit Fälligkeit {date} verwerfen?: Discard the collection due on {date}? The open items it contains will be available for collection again. If you have already submitted the file to your bank, discarding it here changes nothing there.
translations.Diese Zeile war offenbar keine Rücklasts: This row was not a return after all? It will count as pending again. Please check the status of the matching open item yourself.
translations.Rein optionales Zusatzmodul für Vereine,: A purely optional add-on for clubs that collect membership fees by direct debit. A mandate belongs either to a Nextcloud account or to a free-text payer – the latter for federations that only collect fee shares from their branches and keep no individual members. If you do not need this, simply ignore this section.
translations.Gläubiger-ID und einziehendes Konto werd: The creditor identifier and the collecting account are needed for the SEPA collection further down. In Germany the creditor identifier is issued on request by the Bundesbank; the collecting account must have an IBAN on file.
translations.Mandat für „{name}\" widerrufen? Es wird: Revoke the mandate for “{name}”? It will no longer be used for new collections.
translations.Das sieht nicht nach einer SEPA-Gläubige: That does not look like a SEPA creditor identifier (expected something like DE98ZZZ09999999999).
translations.Das einziehende Konto muss ein Geldkonto: The collecting account must be a cash or bank account.
translations.Für das einziehende Konto ist keine IBAN: The collecting account has no IBAN on file. Please add it to the account first.
translations.Das gewählte einziehende Konto wurde nic: The selected collecting account was not found.
translations.Bitte entweder einen Nextcloud-Nutzer od: Please give either a Nextcloud user or a free-text payer name, not both.
translations.Bitte einen Nextcloud-Nutzer oder einen: Please give a Nextcloud user or a free-text payer name.
translations.Das gewählte Ertragskonto wurde nicht ge: The selected income account was not found.
translations.Das gewählte SEPA-Mandat wurde nicht gef: The selected SEPA mandate was not found.
The selected SEPA mandate has been revoked.
translations.Das gewählte SEPA-Mandat gehört zu einem: The selected SEPA mandate belongs to a different payer.
translations.Das Fälligkeitsdatum darf nicht in der V: The due date must not be in the past.
translations.Bitte zuerst die SEPA-Gläubiger-ID in de: Please enter the SEPA creditor identifier in the settings first.
translations.Bitte zuerst den Vereinsnamen in den Ein: Please enter the club name in the settings first.
translations.Bitte zuerst das einziehende Konto in de: Please choose the collecting account in the settings first.
translations.Das eingestellte einziehende Konto wurde: The configured collecting account was not found.
translations.Das einziehende Konto hat keine IBAN hin: The collecting account has no IBAN on file.
translations.Keine bis zum %s fälligen offenen Posten: No open items with a SEPA mandate are due by %s.
translations.Dieser Einzug enthält bereits eine Rückl: This collection already contains a return and can no longer be discarded.
translations.Diese Zeile ist nicht als Rücklastschrif: This row is not marked as a return.
translations.Dieses Mandat wird noch verwendet (%1$s: This mandate is still in use (%1$s collection rows, %2$s fees, %3$s open items) and cannot be deleted. Revoke it instead – it will then no longer be used for new collections but stays traceable.
translations.%1$s wird am %2$s einen Betrag von %3$s: %1$s will collect %3$s from your account by SEPA direct debit on %2$s (mandate reference %4$s).
translations.Bitte sorgen Sie für ausreichende Deckun: Please make sure your account has sufficient funds. If you have any questions, contact the treasurer.
